newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 30-day muni supply rises to $7.021 bln.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 30-day muni supply rises to $7.021 bln.

text.p: Reuters said Tuesday it calculated its 30-day visible supply of upcoming municipal bond sales at $7.021 billion, up $122 million from Friday.

Negotiated sales total $5.791 billion in 68 issues and competitive bond sales total $1.229 billion in 101 issues. Reuters visible supply counts all deals underwriters have either scheduled for sale in the next 30 business days, or have said they tentatively plan to price during the period.

The supply figure is based on sales data compiled by Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group and uses municipal securities with maturities 13 months or longer. All bond deals $1 million or larger are included.
